method: Aseprite MCP preview, ASCII, filmstrip, onion skin, per-layer validation, composited pixel checks, actual browser review

coldRead.knight: Armoured medieval knight; visor and plume, gold heater shield, plated stance.
coldRead.hollow: Undead raider; rust helmet, ivory skull and ribs, spiked wooden club.
coldRead.warden: Heavy olive ogre; tusked jaw, spiked collar, large articulated fists.
coldRead.wisp: Hooded spectral caster; luminous eyes, wispy tail, casting hands.

changes: Rebuilt plate armour and articulated boots; authored four facing sets and planted attack poses.
Replaced rectangular sword cap with a seven-pixel taper ending at a single pixel; updated every equipment cel.
Replaced enemy king with a native-size ogre; changed hollow weapon to a club and wisp to a hooded wraith.
Joined diagonal FX strokes into continuous clusters and synchronized impact with attack phases.
acceptedStyleNotes: Selective outlines differ across metal, bone, cloth and glow layers. Hidden layer edges deliberately overlap; composite structure is connected. Wraith is intentionally airborne.
referenceDeviations: Game-scale simplification of local reference: fewer vents, plate seams and cloth folds; four authored views instead of a full portrait reconstruction.
